meta.title: Artem Amaro - Piazzolla "Adios Nonino" Tango Rhapsody
meta.description_note: 16 June 2013, Royal Conservatoire of Scotland, Glasgow, UK (from video description)

method.melody: harmonic-salience top-line tracking (STFT salience, A3-C7, Viterbi-style continuity, high-register bias); pYIN was tried but voiced probability was too low on this polyphonic recording

meta.caveat: Melody is an estimate of the top voice of a polyphonic recording, not a transcription.
